newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean basis values flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean basis values flat.

text.p: FOB grain and soybean basis values were steady on Thursday amid quiet conditions as the market entered a seasonal lull ahead of the Thanksgiving Day holiday, export sources said.
"It's not uncommon for this time of year to get into a holiday move," one broker said. "We'll see a flurry of activity in the first weeks of December and then things will die down again."
News environmental group Greenpeace had disrupted operations at an ADM terminal in New Orleans on Thursday had no noticeable impact on export markets, brokers said.
Greenpeace was protesting against genetically altered soybeans, saying the beans could cause health problems.
"It didn't seem to do anything," a broker said. "Everybody I was talking to today just wanted to know if there were any naked women there."
He was referring to a protest in Rome on Wednesday during which activists stripped off their clothing and said they would tell the "naked truth" about genetically altered soybeans.
